test_cases.tc_title: The SW shall validate the received diagnostic request format and parameters. ($283F, NRC 13 incorrectMessageLengthOrInvalidFormat)
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. The rearview camera brightness level is recorded as Brightness_initial
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Send a read request for DID $283F with an invalid message length
   $ 22 28 3F
2. Read the rearview camera brightness level
   $ 22 28 3F
test_cases.expected_result:
1. The negative response 7F 22 13 (incorrectMessageLengthOrInvalidFormat) is received
2. The reported rearview camera brightness level equals Brightness_initial
test_cases.split_reason: R-DIAG1(b)：037 之 negative 列述三種失效型態（invalid length／incorrect format／unsupported DID），依 IN §8.3 拆 sibling；本條為長度軸，區分 token 為 NRC 13
test_cases.remarks: Harman Scope: Need Rework; NRC per ISO 14229-1 (037 unspecified)
pc_sources: PC-1: SYSAD §4.5 Session & Security Assumptions（ECU starts in Default Session）
PC-2: SYSAD §4.5 Hardware Dependencies（Diagnostic connector (OBD-II)）
PC-3: R-11(f) baseline 前例（IN §8.7.5(f)）

test_cases.tc_title: The SW shall support read and write access for the Cabin EQ Curve Number DID. (read $280C, SID 22)
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Read the Cabin EQ Curve Number
   $ 22 28 0C
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The positive response 62 28 0C <Cabin EQ Curve Number byte> is received, and the reported value is the Cabin EQ Curve Number currently applied by the radio
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
test_cases.split_reason: R-DIAG1(b)：037 述本 DID 對該設定同時 readable 與 writeable，讀（0x22）與寫（0x2E）為不同服務且可觀察結果不同，依 IN §8.3 拆 sibling；本條為讀向，區分 token 為 SID 22

test_cases.tc_title: The SW shall validate the received diagnostic request format and parameters. ($2870, NRC 13 incorrectMessageLengthOrInvalidFormat)
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. The enumerated USB device count is recorded as Count_initial
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Send a read request for DID $2870 with an invalid message length
   $ 22 28 70
2. Read the enumerated USB device count
   $ 22 28 70
test_cases.expected_result:
1. The negative response 7F 22 13 (incorrectMessageLengthOrInvalidFormat) is received
2. The reported enumerated USB device count equals Count_initial
test_cases.split_reason: R-DIAG1(b)：037 之 negative 列述三種失效型態（invalid length／incorrect format／unsupported DID），依 IN §8.3 拆 sibling；本條為長度軸，區分 token 為 NRC 13
pc_sources: PC-1: SYSAD §4.5 Session & Security Assumptions（ECU starts in Default Session）
PC-2: SYSAD §4.5 Hardware Dependencies（Diagnostic connector (OBD-II)）
PC-3: R-11(f) baseline 前例（IN §8.7.5(f)）

test_cases.tc_title: SW shall support DID $1820 to report the status of the Push Button Control Interface. (read $1820, twelve push buttons)
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. No push button on the Push Button Control Interface is pressed
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Read the Push Button Control Interface status
   $ 22 18 20
2. Press and hold the "Power" push button
3. Read the Push Button Control Interface status again
   $ 22 18 20
test_cases.expected_result:
1. The positive response 62 18 20 <push button status record> is received, and the record reports the status of:
   a. Power
   b. Up
   c. Down
   d. Select
   e. Dark
   f. Mute
   g. Back
   h. Radio
   i. Player
   j. Nav
   k. Phone
   l. More
2. The "Power" push button is held pressed
3. The positive response 62 18 20 <push button status record> is received, and the record reports the "Power" push button as pressed
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
pc_sources: PC-1: SYSAD §4.5 Session & Security Assumptions（ECU starts in Default Session）
PC-2: SYSAD §4.5 Hardware Dependencies（Diagnostic connector (OBD-II)）
PC-3: CFTS004-4939646（…report the status of the following push buttons）
